items.description: The 99designs Tasks Slack Bot is a full featured graphic design assistant application in Slack.
A mashup based on the Sick Bay Scanner from the original Star Trek. It uses the Yahoo YUI API to capture a stock price and a handful of stock ratios which it applies to the scanner.
Display weather radio stations on map.
Use this bookmarklet to view a Twitter user's trstrank in your browser.
Create online video mixtapes to share with friends. Search for artists or songs on YouTube. Drag results into your list to create your own mixtape.
Ahoy Hoy! allows you to talk to a random stranger about interesting topics. Just pick a topic that you find interesting (topics provided) and talk to others that are also interested in that topic.
Using an integration of the Google Maps API and TRAFFY developed by NECTEC, this app shows realtime traffic information in Bangkok.
Google maps and Celebrity web data combined to see exactly where your favorite celebrity lives.

Fitabase is a research platform that collects data from internet connected consumer devices. Fitabase is for anyone wanting to aggregate, analyze, and export data gathered from many device wearers. With this service, organizations will be able to safely gather and analyze their data for their business. Fitabase provides the customers with visual live data along with the ability to easily download and read their content in a standard spreadsheet format.
Review mashup for new Turkish President Mr. Abdullah Gul. You can enter the location where you live and put reviews on the map about Mr. Abdullah Gul.
Maps of breweries and bars across the US. With city-specific maps and directories.
Map based search for lowest petrol price and station locations around Western Australia.
WishAlert.me monitors your Amazon.com wishlist for price drops and sends you an SMS alert when it finds one.
View a map that uses custom map types to create a 3D stylized map of Hong Kong.
MountainsMounts.com provides over 100,000 mountain peaks geo information and shows the mountains on a map.
CodexMap lets you find, and place, books graphically on a map. Whether the book was added to the system by our harvester, or by you or another user, you can interact with a map to find books.
Google Maps mashup for those wanting to discover new restaurants in a specific area.

Connected with the Walgreens Balance Rewards program, this fitbit application allow users to keep track of their activity to earn Walgreens points. With a 'steps' program, customers will be able to set goals and view progress of their activities, while earning reward points at Walgreens.
Mashes up MLS home listings with bank-owned property records to flag active listings as bank-owned. Allows the bargain-hunter buyer to identify homes for sale owned by a bank.
Enabling record labels to offer previews to artist fan clubs months in advance of releases, driving up pre-sales.
Let Santa Call makes phone calls to your friends, and play them a Christmas song.
Search and view KML files on the map. Looks for KML files with Google AJAX Search, then shows the KML file content in a Google map.
